blocks.text: Conflicts often arise when stakeholders have competing priorities. Businesses aim to collect data for innovation and profit, while users value privacy and control over personal information. Governments must balance economic growth with protecting citizens' rights and maintaining ethical standards.

A common example of conflict is data collection practices. Companies may gather large amounts of user data to improve AI performance, but without explicit consent, this violates privacy and trust. Transparent data policies and user-friendly consent mechanisms help achieve a fair balance between functionality and ethics.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Balancing privacy and innovation is one of the biggest challenges in today's tech-driven world.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Role-play a company meeting where developers want to collect user data and privacy advocates oppose it. Discuss solutions.
